title: Finite lift and descent datum for an étale section on the closed subscheme
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Suppose that for every sheaf of sets $G$ on the underlying Zariski space of $X$, the canonical restriction $\Gamma(X,G)\to\Gamma(Z,i^{-1}_{\mathrm{Zar}}G)$ is bijective, with topological inverse image as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. Suppose also that for every finite morphism $h:X'\to X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], the same assertion holds for the base-changed closed immersion $i':Z'=Z\times_XX'\to X'$ and every Zariski sheaf of sets on $X'$. For every sheaf of sets $F$ on $X_{\rm et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] and every $t\in\Gamma(Z,i^{-1}_{\rm et}F)$, there exist a finite surjective $h:X\prime\to X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-surjective-morphism] and $s\prime\in\Gamma(X\prime,h^{-1}_{\rm et}F)$ whose two projection pullbacks to $X\prime\times_X X\prime$ agree [def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-sets-finite-surjective-descent]. Moreover, writing $Z\prime=Z\times_X X\prime$, $h_Z:Z\prime\to Z$, and $i\prime:Z\prime\to X\prime$, the composite-inverse-image identifications give $c_{i,h_Z}(h_Z^*t)=c_{h,i\prime}(i\prime^*s\prime)$, transported along $h_Z\circ i=i\prime\circ h$ [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. This asserts a lift on a finite cover with its descent equation, not a section on X.

proof.text: Use gabber_h0_finite_section to obtain the finite surjective morphism h and the section s′ with its closed-fibre restriction equation. Install the returned IsFinite instance.

For Y = X′ ×_X X′ the composite a = p_1 followed by h is finite by finite base change and composition. Its closed fibre j : Z ×_X Y → Y is a closed immersion. Apply gabber_h0_etale_injective to j, the Zariski bijectivity supplied by hFinite applied to a, and G = a^*F. This gives injectivity at the identity object of Y.Etale. Transport to the terminal base-change object U along the unique terminal-object isomorphism: naturality of the inverse-image unit sends equality at U to equality at the identity object; apply injectivity and then the inverse isomorphism on sections. This is the proved private helper unit_injective_terminal.
gabber_h0_projection_restrictions gives equality under this injective unit. Cancel it to prove equality of the two projection pullbacks and pair this equality with the original closed-fibre equation.
